name: Volumes — the regular slices of a series become one volume
notes: A CT, MR, PT or NM series can be a volume, except for some images that
are not on the regular slice spacing: an extra slice, a slice at another
angle, or a slice between two positions. The default `volume3d` rule puts
all of them in one display set, which is then not reconstructable.
With this rule, the regular slices become one volume display set, in
position order. The other images stay with the default rules.
`mixesIrregular` is a series value: the series has a complete regular
lattice of 3 or more slices, and also other images. Remove
`&& planeGeometry.complete` to accept a lattice with a missing slice.
A fully regular series, and a series with no lattice, keep the default
Priority -2: the rule runs before every default rule, and before the

regularVolume.description: Volume series with some irregular images: the regular slices become one volume display set.
